description: This file defines the 'Note' class, a data model representing a note in a notes organizer application. It includes properties for id, title, content, creation and update timestamps, and an optional category ID. The class provides factory and serialization methods to convert between Map representations and class instances, as well as a copyWith method for creating modified copies.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A class representing a note with properties for id, title, content, timestamps, and category.

methods.name: Note.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Note instance from a Map, parsing date strings into DateTime objects.

methods.name: Note.toMap
methods.description: Serializes the Note instance into a Map, with an option to include the id.

methods.name: Note.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note with optional new values for properties.
